correctness.rationale: Full formal EGF is obtained from the published bijection by exact signed-block weights: singleton \(u\); for \(s\ge2\), weights \(t(u^{s-1}+u^s)+(2^{s-1}-2)t^2u^{s-1}\), and zero-block weights \(u\) or \(tu^z\); only ascent joins. Direct word enumeration and independent block recurrence agree \(1\le n\le8\). The all-order proof does not appeal to a finite census.
